title: Trajectory, *upward*
subtitle: From a first React Native experiment to an app with a community. Dates are from my GitHub.

items.title: Hello, GitHub
items.text: Account created from Nepal. Bio: “I am good. What else you want to know about me 😔”. Still accurate.

items.title: First repo
items.text: A React Native app, mostly to learn new things. It started the habit of building to learn.

items.title: Breaking things to understand them
items.text: C pwn exercises, a Go hello world, tinkering with a recovery tree for my Realme 3 Pro, and the first build of my own Arch distro with Hyprland.

items.title: Writing a language
items.text: Hyper Compiler, my own language in JavaScript. In the same month: a root ISO mounter for Android and a Rust anime downloader.

items.title: Hooking Android
items.text: Xposed modules: invisible Gboard keys for touch-typing practice, and the Nepali date hooked into the system clock.

items.title: College, shipped
items.text: Loksewa app in Flutter, a C++ compiler, phphelper on Composer, and CodeWave, my 7th-semester project with a word2vec recommender. Then Nepali typing tools and PDF → Unicode.

items.title: Frameworks and fleets
items.text: Spark, my own virtual-DOM framework. Rust CLIs to update a server full of Laravel apps, zsh helpers, and my first SolidJS experiments.

items.title: AntiGem lifts off
items.text: An AI coding workspace for Android: four agents, a real Linux, an editor and a browser the agent drives. A custom Termux bootstrap pipeline the same week.

items.title: An ecosystem in a week
items.text: AntiGem for VS Code (Marketplace + Open VSX), a Chrome bridge, an official plugin repo, signed Termux:X11 and Termux:API builds, and a mini-app store. 123★ and 67 forks.

items.title: Whatever defies gravity
items.text: If it seems impossible on a phone, that's the next thing I want to try.
